title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 4.61 (versions follow prime numbers; 461 after 457): her school sings what she says again. Since her thinker speaks, no song reached her school, which lives in her body, and Tab showed nothing; now her body sings each answer of her thinker to her school. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v4.61: su escuela vuelve a cantar. Prototipo de investigación.
